name: getname-hfs
script:
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/getname-hfs")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/getname-hfs/a.txt")
filegetname ((POSIX file "$TMP/getname-hfs/a.txt") as text)

name: remove-filesonly
script:
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly")
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly/d")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly/d/a.txt")
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly/d/e")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly/d/e/b.txt")
fileremove (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly/d") with filesonly
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly/d/a.txt")
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly/d/e/b.txt")
filegetname (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly/d/e")

fileremove (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly-subfolder-file/d") with filesonly

name: remove-filesonly-after
script:
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly-after")
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly-after/d")
writetext "x" to (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly-after/d/a.txt")
fileremove (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly-after/d") with filesonly after date "Saturday, January 1, 2000 at 12:00:00 AM"
readtext (POSIX file "$TMP/remove-filesonly-after/d/a.txt")

name: mkdtemp-wildcards
script:
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/mkdtemp-wildcards")
mkdtemp (POSIX file "$TMP/mkdtemp-wildcards/") name "d" wildcards 8

name: filemove-case-only
script:
mkdir (POSIX file "$TMP/filemove-case-only")
writetext "keep" to (POSIX file "$TMP/filemove-case-only/a.txt")
filemove (POSIX file "$TMP/filemove-case-only/a.txt") to (POSIX file "$TMP/filemove-case-only") name "A.txt"
